description: This Java class manages Bluetooth connections for an Android chat application, including setting up server sockets, initiating connections, and handling data transmission threads.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth connection states, threads for listening, connecting, and data transfer, and handles communication with UI via Handler.

classes.name: AcceptThread
classes.description: Thread that listens for incoming Bluetooth connection requests.

classes.name: ConnectThread
classes.description: Thread that attempts to establish an outgoing Bluetooth connection.

classes.name: ConnectedThread
classes.description: Thread that manages data transmission over an active Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming connections by initiating AcceptThreads.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to a specified Bluetooth device.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Starts data transfer threads after a successful connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all active threads and resets connection state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data over the active Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: updateUserInterfaceTitle
methods.description: Updates UI based on current connection state.

methods.name: connectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts and restarts listening.

methods.name: connectionLost
methods.description: Handles lost connections and restarts listening.
